name: _llseek
synopsis: int syscall(SYS__llseek, unsigned int fd, unsigned long offset_high, unsigned long offset_low, loff_t *result, unsigned int whence);
description: The _llseek() system call repositions the offset of the open file associated with the file descriptor fd to a 64-bit value formed by offset_high and offset_low, relative to the position specified by whence. It stores the new file offset in the result parameter. This system call is primarily used on 32-bit platforms to handle large file offsets.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the open file

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: Pointer to a location where the new file offset is stored

parameters.name: whence
parameters.description: Reference position for the offset (SEEK_SET, SEEK_CUR, or SEEK_END)

return_value.failure: Returns -1 and sets errno to indicate the error

errors.description: fd is not an open file descriptor
